surfaces.label: Shape
surfaces.appearance: Shared no-imagery grid over source geometry; not observed surface color or albedo.

surfaces.label: Chang’e-2
surfaces.coverage: A cropped 2012 flyby photograph, approximately placed on the radar shape; excluded terrain stays gridded.

registration.method: Camera direction inferred from Zou et al. (2014), Figure 3, using the angles quoted by Bu et al. (2015). Scale and translation manually match the published radar rendering; its photograph is matched to Jiang et al. (2015), Figure 1c. The image-to-image holdouts do not validate the 3D placement. See source/reference/chang-e-2-method.md.
registration.limitations: Approximate placement on the 1992/1996 radar model. Absolute image-to-shape registration has not been measured. Camera-axis interpretation and figure framing are inferred, and the radar model differs from the photographed surface. Transfer limits and coverage describe this assumed projection, not positional accuracy.

geometry.interpretation: Geometry under the assumed orthographic projection; no measured camera range or Sun direction.

frames.footprintInterpretation: Size of an enlarged figure pixel under the assumed projection; not native detector resolution or registration accuracy.

limits.interpretation: Transfer bounds on the assumed projection. They do not measure absolute image-to-shape alignment.

colorDisplay.interpretation: Published colors and illumination retained; neither calibrated reflectance nor reconstructed natural color.

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed

observation.previewPolicy: The flat preview samples unique radial intersections only; the retained triangle atlas samples the closest full-source surface point in 3D.
observation.limitations: Approximate placement on the 1992/1996 radar model. Absolute image-to-shape registration has not been measured. Camera-axis interpretation and figure framing are inferred, and the radar model differs from the photographed surface. Transfer limits and coverage describe this assumed projection, not positional accuracy.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point; all bilinear observation contributors checked before interpolation; atlas bleed clamped to retained face.
